name: ColorField
summary: A field for a colour: the swatch in front and the code — hex, rgb(), hsl() or hsb() — applied on Enter or when it loses focus; or one channel as a number. Inside a Field, the label, description and error are the Field's.

a11y.apg: A text field (the code) or, with channel, a spinbutton with the channel's range and its value written ("208°, vivid blue"). The swatch in front is decorative. Inside a Field, the label names it, the description describes it and the error marks it invalid.
a11y.keyboardNote: Enter applies the code (so does leaving the field); text that is not a colour goes back. With channel, the arrows move one step, Page Up/Down the large step, Home/End the ends.

props.name: value
props.description: The colour, in hex or rgb()/hsl()/hsb(); "" is the empty field. Controlled.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The starting colour when you do not control it. Without it, the field starts empty.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when the code is applied (Enter or leaving the field) and on every key in a channel, with the hex — or "" when it is cleared.

props.name: onValueCommitted
props.description: Called with onValueChange — the moment to save.

props.name: channel
props.description: One channel, as a number, in place of the code: hue, saturation, brightness, lightness, red, green, blue or alpha.

props.name: colorSpace
props.description: With channel: the space of hue and saturation.

props.name: swatch
props.default: true for the code, false for a channel
props.description: The swatch in front.

props.name: size
props.description: The field height, the same scale as Input.

props.name: variant
props.description: secondary is the neutral background, for a field inside a card — the same as Input.

props.name: width
props.description: The field width — "20rem" or "auto". Without it, the whole line, like the other fields.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The field does not take input.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Shown and focusable, not editable.

props.name: required
props.description: Inside a Field, Field's required does it.

props.name: name
props.description: Sends the colour with a form, as hex.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while the field is empty.

props.name: id
props.description: Id of the input — what a label points at. Inside a Field, the Field gives it one.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the field when there is no visible label.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Names the field by another element's id.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: Goes to the input. Inside a Field, the description and the error are added.

props.name: aria-invalid
props.description: Marks the value as rejected. Inside a Field, the error does it.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the group, after the Aurea skin.
